attempted_claim: Let S be a Sylow 5-subgroup of the Monster sporadic simple group M, and let F be either of the two exotic saturated fusion systems on S with O_5(F)=1 classified in van Beek, Theorem C. Is F block-realizable — i.e., does there exist a finite group G and a 5-block b of kG (k algebraically closed of characteristic 5) with defect group D isomorphic to S such that F is isomorphic to F_{(D,e_D)}(G,b)? In particular, prove or disprove that each such F is block-exotic.
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of block-realizability was established for any van Beek Theorem C exotic on the Sylow 5-subgroup of the Monster. The H branch still needs a p=5 cross-characteristic Lie defect bound, alternating-weight defect identification, and verified defining-characteristic and sporadic block scope; the D-family still needs a generalized reduction for non-reduction-simple systems; automizer and Atlas 5-local data could not be verified without MAGMA. No emergent finding is claimed.
